blocks.code:
import pse

pse.initialize()

stairs = pse.Stairs()
stairs.create(location=(0, 0, -100))

stairs.color_on = (0, 255, 0)
stairs.color_off = (255, 0, 0)

# Поднять лестницу
stairs.state = 1
